steps: Qualify both original full-project bundle and sealed project-Baseline sources using complete defined 0.2 native model, profile/rule, document/include/view, configuration, lifecycle, primary-document and specialist checks. Retain immutable Evidence, Baselines, RelationReviews and terminal Proposals together with exact recursive archives and attachments. Keep negative, stale and independent-policy findings distinct from current approvals; reject identity, revision, closure and byte conflicts before writes.

Read original ordinary transaction, unpublished discard, recovery, takeover and prior Restore completions with their native audit/receipt/intent/target contracts. Retain exact original paths and bytes; a completion label or hash without its required proof is insufficient.

Supply complete current native Requirement review, Task-Done, CodeReference and source observations through explicit trusted host services. Recompute context/model/projection bindings and reobserve external verifiers on active calls. Reject absent, stale, forged, nonhuman, rejected and foreign proofs; no project/plan/Work data may provide a callback or grant.

Reconstruct Proposal content, native original basis and actual operation/plan fold, complete control revision chain and verifier-bound original review observations. Include nested management-like field names and extensions in content hashes; only actual distinct human test actors fulfill quorum. Reject withdrawn/repeated/AI approvals, stale approved bases and missing native applied completion.

Preserve valid rejected, stale and applied Proposal originals as historical results without new Apply or status migration. Test ordinary/public/structured/planning/Work use of the same native Proposal core and fresh services for active work; completed passive Work uses only its retained original evidence.

Prepare a closed passive plan read-only, with separate original-byte/canonical hashes, immutable source, inventory, preservation and backup projections. Publish exact plan bytes only to an explicit create-only external output after fresh source/root/parent/staging checks; invalid plan, source, inventory or output remains write-free.

Read original plan and journal-selection inputs passively through bound native descriptors. Preserve old closed plan/Work/journal bytes and independently reread exact external inputs; reading is not authority and does not require vanished source transport after publication.

Execute only with independent current host authority, original actor/request, exact plan/target/source/inventory and explicit normalized affected-journal selection under the native project mutex. Repeat current checks before forward writes; unselected journals, malformed selections, stale state and denied grants block without new project effects.

Synchronize and read back complete original backup objects/directories and staged target bytes before publication; verify actual full target before immutable action audit and selected-journal archival. Never discard completed receipts, unselected originals or unexplained own-namespace entries.

After a real interruption, derive actual effect prefixes from complete original inventory and journals. Finish only a proven full target without republishing normative bytes, including source loss; roll back only a proven partial target from original before images and retain original journals/recovery barriers. Never use a cursor or passive result as authority for forward recovery.

Transfer project/Restore ownership only with exact expected original owner hash, explicit current takeover grant and applicable risk consent under the real inode mutex. Reject live owners, held mutexes, foreign/stale or reused identities; preserve old/new bytes and immutable intent/completion proof across repeated process and IO failures.

Recover an orphan outer Restore Work owner separately through the bound retained checkpoint chain and native host/boot/PID/start observation. Require current explicit handoff consent; preserve exact old/new owner and handoff originals. Work owner, current project recovery authority and original Restore request remain distinct.

Expose recover.restore through public argv/structured handlers, native request and result schemas, installed capability/self-description and typed host context. Enforce both source kinds, planning/execution mode exclusion, explicit operational Baseline values, lexical roots, current authoring and semantic error contracts; no input-label authorization.

Capture a partitioned planning snapshot into immutable external Work input, repeatedly prove actual source/current observations, qualify the complete target and deliver exact original plan bytes. Interrupted delivery or a missing terminal checkpoint requires fresh active qualification; completed delivery is not silently redone.

Execute and deliver Restore through public Work under one retained outer owner/mutex and fresh independent native project grants. Retain complete native completion, original output variants and result manifests before confirming units and final checkpoint. Work progress cannot replace native journal truth or authorize duplicate publication.

Support passive bound Work status/prompt, cancel with exact reason/state, export/restore and active resume. Reject tampered chains/objects/results, incompatible roots/build or stale ownership. Completed replay after project/source/output/host loss returns exact retained result bytes with native_execution_checked=false and checkpoint_changed=false; no new write or specialist work occurs.

Inject actual abrupt process exits and native EIO/ENOSPC/short-or-zero-write/fsync/response-loss faults at backup/staging, intent/prepared/committing markers, partial/full target, audit/journal archival, owner exchange, rollback, external output and Work checkpoint/result boundaries. Check exact actual surviving files, active barriers and fresh authorized completion or rollback, including repeated failures.

Exchange opened roots and parents with byte-identical, vanished or linked trees before mode/replace/unlink/rename/rmdir effects, including between staging sync and publication. Reject detached handles before additional effects; preserve original inode/namespace, staging and backup evidence.

Reject declared unsupported 0.1/unknown normative schemas and Legacy registrations in source, current or required archive/attachment closure with Code 3 before project/internal operational/original writes. Enforce the same public planning/structured/Work boundary; do not silently skip, migrate or invent a supported legacy contract. Opaque foreign attachments and defined 0.2 legacy_ids retain their existing meaning.

Keep invalid/unsupported input Code 3, missing operational values Code 2, real IO Code 5, identity/stale-content conflict Code 6 and native path/root safety Code 7 distinct. Work partial continuation Code 8 is not completion. Current catalog implementation coverage is separate from pending frozen-state Dev/Apply execution evidence, full-suite results and human product release approval.
